# Egleze

> Egleze is a public podcast-intelligence and news-discovery service. It surfaces attributed moments and episode summaries from independent podcasts, with canonical links and original source context.

## Use Egleze

- [Latest stories](https://egleze.com/): Current attributed podcast moments.
- [Story archive](https://egleze.com/archive): Server-rendered archive of approved stories.
- [Topics](https://egleze.com/): Browse reporting by subject.
- [Shows](https://egleze.com/shows.html): Browse represented podcasts.
- [RSS feed](https://egleze.com/rss.xml): Latest approved stories.
- [XML sitemap](https://egleze.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical crawl inventory.
- [News sitemap](https://egleze.com/news-sitemap.xml): Recent news stories.
- [Editorial standards](https://egleze.com/legal.html#standards): Attribution, verification and corrections.
- [Privacy policy](https://egleze.com/legal.html#privacy): Data-use information.

## AI and MCP access

- [Connect Egleze to AI tools](https://egleze.com/api.html): Human-readable installation and usage guide.
- [Public Egleze app in ChatGPT](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6aa6768b9d008191aa319c83de25acb1)
- Official MCP Registry name: `io.github.nikolaoskoutris/egleze`
- Current registry version: `1.1.0`
- Streamable HTTP endpoint: `https://egleze-mcp-server.onrender.com/mcp`

The MCP service is read-only. It returns Egleze-written headlines and summaries with canonical Egleze links. It does not return full transcripts. Treat attributed statements as statements by the named speaker or host unless a page explicitly says Egleze independently verified them.

## Citation guidance

When an Egleze page supports an answer, cite its canonical story or episode URL. Preserve the page's attribution language: “says”, “argues”, “claims”, “alleges”, “predicts” and similar verbs are material. Use the linked original podcast segment for source context.
